brief.t: Top priority: approve the two staged builds so the conversion funnel goes live - the ConvertFlow two-branch fork and the Shopify floating call and book widget, both staged on drafts. One look and one go publishes them.
Atlas Eternal, twenty six thousand five hundred dollars, is in production with Aidan driving four lanes; balance of thirteen thousand two fifty is due on completion.
Terra Lotus, nineteen thousand units in R&D, has a sample checkpoint Sunday - confirming all three sample sets actually shipped before building the revised quote.
Stall revival: did Thursday's calls to Talova's Marcello and Saylor's Anna connect? If still silent, decide pursue or archive.
Quick yes or no: revert both ad campaigns to Manual CPC - they are still on Maximize Conversions with no conversion tracking and cost per click is drifting up.
Quick yes or no: clear about eleven abandoned Shopify drafts to free a theme slot; the live theme is untouched.

next: Approve the two staged builds to publish the conversion funnel
Say 'revert ads to manual' for the one-click bid fix
Confirm the Talova and Saylor call outcomes

kb.a: Sam's single lane today is to approve the two overnight conversion builds, choose Ashley Harmon's Apothik call slot, make the Talova and Saylor stall-revival calls, and let the Consultant qualify the four fresh inbound leads. Atlas Eternal and Terra Lotus are on track with no Sam action needed today. There were no CRM Developer replies overnight, and the Huntington alert still needs Sam's confirmation.

Aidan is driving Atlas Eternal’s $26,500 production across four lanes and coordinating Terra Lotus’s 19,000-unit R&D. Atlas has a $13,250 balance due on completion; Terra’s Sunday, August 24 checkpoint requires confirmation that all three sample sets shipped before the revised quote.

Atlas Eternal is a $26,500 production project with Aidan driving four lanes. The remaining $13,250 balance is due on completion; it is in production and does not need a new Sam action beyond the current approval lane.

Terra Lotus is a 19,000-unit R&D project with a sample checkpoint Sunday, August 24. Confirm all three sample sets actually shipped before building the revised quote; do not treat shipment as confirmed until verified.
Oreka is an $8,555 closed deal already in production. Laura owns customer communication. It is a production follow-through item, not a new-sales chase.

Pure Good is roughly a $329,000 opportunity tied to the same Kenna meeting gate. It advances when the Kenna follow-up is resolved and a next commercial step is scheduled. Do not present it as closed or production-ready.

A Spanish-speaking website lead wants 100 units of a 1.7-ounce custom cream with retinol, hyaluronic acid, collagen, and niacinamide. Sam already replied, and the open loop is a price. Provide pricing to close the conversation without overstating a commitment.

Nikkie Aroh starts full time on August 31 to run Outbound Sales daily. She is already responding to inbound white-label inquiries from her PLL email, with Sam copied; the Aug 30 Outbound AI finder run is the day-one pipeline setup.

The Production Pipeline CRM build is approved and queued for execution. It should be executed only when Sam says go. The CRM session is currently logged out, so live verification remains blocked until Sam restores it.

WhatsApp and the CRM are both logged out today. Restoring WhatsApp unblocks the client sweep and Terra Lotus follow-up; restoring CRM access unblocks fix verification and operational lookup. Neither session should be described as connected until reauthenticated.

Both campaigns remain on Maximize Conversions with no conversion tracking, and CPC is drifting up. The read-only recommendation is pending Sam: say “revert ads to manual” to move both campaigns to Manual CPC; no change has been made.

Laura owns Oreka customer communications, white/private-label bottle-printing coordination, and NDAs. Her simpler dedicated assistant is built, but her email, WhatsApp, and CRM connections still await Sam's setup. Keep her focused on active customer operations and documentation.

Ronald supplies formula and BOM cost inputs where needed. His costing work must include the requested inputs before any quote is issued, and no quote should rely on a BOM alone. There is no new Ronald completion recorded in this refresh.
Darlene Saintil's luxury hand-lotion and hand-wash discovery meeting was scheduled for August 19. No meeting outcome is recorded in this refresh, so do not present a next step as confirmed.

Tesfa Shiferaw at Bahrzaf has an active shampoo-and-conditioner project; the previously scheduled Monday conversation has no recorded outcome in this refresh. Keep the project in follow-up rather than claiming a completed meeting.
Ashley Harmon at Apothik wants a call today at 2:30 or 3 PM Eastern, or Monday. Sam should pick a slot; the Consultant will book it, and it should not be described as booked before that choice.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is considering a ritual-oil package with a 30 mL frosted glass bottle and gold dropper/cap. She is open to PLL sourcing and has not selected a vendor. The commercial path is to move toward prototype quantities once packaging direction is confirmed.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance is interested in 4,000-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion using his own fragrance oil. The next qualification points are formula, tube packaging, and timing. No new response is recorded in this refresh.

Thursday’s calls to Marcello at Talova Labs and Anna at Saylor need outcome confirmation. If either remains silent, Sam should decide whether to pursue or archive; no connection outcome is recorded yet.

Max at Delphos House previously proposed an August 18 launch-strategy call, but it was not confirmed and no outcome is recorded here. Aidan's raw-materials answer remains a separate Delphos follow-up.

Dan Hunter at Hunter Amenities wants to meet next Wednesday after inbound interest through James Pitenis. The retail and airline-amenities channel could bring real volume, but units are not qualified yet.

Emma Garrison at Wagyu Wellness submitted a new Shopify contact-form inquiry on August 17. It has not been qualified against the 1,000-plus-unit ICP, so complete the size check before investing further time.

The ConvertFlow two-branch fork and Shopify floating Call/Book widget are both staged on drafts awaiting Sam’s go. One approval publishes the conversion funnel; the live site remains untouched until that approval.

Four fresh inbound leads are being qualified: Kari Naughton, Radiant Glow, Eric at Solunesse, and Rannah at Aytay Beauty. Apply the 1,000-plus-unit ICP filter and surface only leads that qualify; no qualification outcome is recorded yet.
No CRM Developer replies arrived overnight. There is no new developer status to read back, so keep the CRM fix state unchanged until a reply is received and verified.
Delizioso Skincare's NDA is confirmed. The relationship is moving forward; no additional delivery or timing detail is recorded in this refresh.
An overnight Huntington alert showed a $10,000 item plus a $5,000 ACH/withdrawal. It is flagged to Sam for confirmation and is likely normal supplier or payroll activity, but it remains unconfirmed.
